label: Exploratory — assumed geometry and masses; contact stiffnesses unknown. Front modelled as two fixed legs (§13); for surge this is equivalent to the bridle, so the peaks apply to both front arrangements.
bem_note: BEM reused from a nearby pose (tier 'approximate'). Checked against an exact BEM for one case: leg peak 2318 N exact vs 2332 N reused (0.6 %), boat roll 11.84 deg vs 12.20 deg. The reuse is adequate for these linear results; an exact BEM costs 347 s per configuration.
time_domain_note: The tension-only time-domain peaks do NOT converge in this configuration: at a rear preload of 2000 N they wander between 11.0 and 15.7 kN from 64 to 1024 steps per period, with a time-domain/linear amplitude ratio of 6-22. With elements this stiff, no element damping and the contacts opening twice per cycle, the integration cannot bound the snatch load. Peaks from it are therefore NOT reported as results; the engagement criterion below is used instead.
